issues.evidence: 封面页面(y 0–540)上半部仅标题与标签，下半蓝色条仅一行说明；内容与页码在底部拥挤，主标题占位过大而信息密度低。
issues.suggestedChange: 缩小标题字号并上移，将底部说明与页码间距拉开，或补充副标题以平衡版式。

issues.evidence: 页码“01 / 03”位于蓝色条右下角(x 808–907,y 504–527)，与左侧说明文字“讨论是否继续周五延时开放”基线不一致，视觉上偏下。
issues.suggestedChange: 将页码与说明文字基线对齐，或统一右下角内边距。

issues.evidence: Both comparison body lines in text-0 ('沿用现有班次。') and text-1 ('需要服务台另排晚班。') sit in tall 129px frames with roughly 70% unused vertical space, while the headline gaps remain uneven, making the two-column body look top-heavy and loosely arranged.
issues.suggestedChange: Tighten the body frame heights to the single-line content or vertically center the two body lines against their headings for an even comparison layout.

issues.evidence: The right comparison column has a full-height tinted panel rect-6 (EAF0FA, y=168–456), but the left column has no panel behind its content, and both the left divider rect-3 (x=53–468) and right divider rect-7 (x=480–895) span different visual treatments.
issues.suggestedChange: Add an equivalent light panel behind the left column or remove the right tinted panel so the two options are visually balanced.
